Shamim Haider Patwary (born 25 September 1981) is a Bangladeshi politician and a former Member of Parliament from Gaibandha-1.
Career
Shamim was elected to parliament as a Jatiya Party candidate from Gaibandha-1 in a March 2018 by-election following the death of the incumbent Member of Parliament, Golam Mostafa Ahmed, of Bangladesh Awami League. He later served as a Member of the 11th parliament from Gaibandha-1 representing the Jatiya Party.
He lost the 2024 general election to Abdullah Nahid Nigar, an Awami League politician who ran as an independent candidate.
